ChartWidget.name: ui
ChartWidget.doc: The widget's look: its corners, sizes, type, lines, shadows and bars. A preset (`'print'`, the default; `'studio'`; `'terminal'`; `'capsule'`) or your theme over one. Colours stay with `theme`.

ChartWidget.name: locale
ChartWidget.doc: UI chrome language (toolbar, watchlist, indicator picker, status bar, settings panel, hotkey sheet). A built-in table ('en', the default, or 'vi'), layered under `messages` for host overrides/additions. Does not translate the data-driven indicator/drawing-tool names from `widgetConfig.ts` — see README "Widget i18n".

ChartWidget.name: messages
ChartWidget.doc: Override or add individual UI strings, on top of `locale`'s built-in table.

ChartWidget.name: features
ChartWidget.doc: The widget's switches, by name (`WIDGET_FEATURES`): every one is on unless set `false` here. A switch hides a part and never adds one: the depth ladder and the watchlist come from their options, so `features: { depthLadder: true }` alone makes no ladder.

ChartWidget.name: rangeBar
ChartWidget.doc: Range presets (1D, 5D, 1M … All) and "go to date" (also Alt+G) on the status bar. Default `true`; needs the status bar.

ChartWidget.name: indicatorLegend
ChartWidget.doc: The indicators on the chart, under the OHLCV legend and at the top of their panes, with show / settings / remove. Default `true`; `false` leaves only the toolbar's indicator count.

ChartWidget.name: replayRevealMarks
ChartWidget.doc: In a replay, show the signal markers and trade zones only as it reaches them (a trade open until its exit). Default `true`; `false` shows them all through the replay.

ChartWidget.name: fullscreen
ChartWidget.doc: Fullscreen button in the toolbar, where the browser allows it. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: alerts
ChartWidget.doc: Price-alerts UI — a bell button in the toolbar that opens a floating panel to add / list / delete price alerts, plus a toast when one triggers. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: alertNotifications
ChartWidget.doc: Sound and/or desktop notification when a price alert triggers. Both off by default. `sound: true` plays a built-in beep; pass a URL for a custom one. `desktop: true` uses the Notification API (asks permission on first use).

ChartWidget.name: objectTree
ChartWidget.doc: Object-tree panel — a layers button in the toolbar that opens a manager listing active indicators and drawings, with per-item show/hide, lock, and delete. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: depthLadder
ChartWidget.doc: The depth-of-market ladder, a click-to-trade order book on a page of the dock. Off until this is `true` (with trading on); its switch only hides it, so `features: { depthLadder: true }` makes none. Feed it with `widget.setDepth`, open it with `widget.openPanel('depthLadder')`, the Trade menu or its rail button. Clicks emit `orderPlace` intents.

ChartWidget.name: accountPanel
ChartWidget.doc: The account panel at the bottom: open positions with their profit and loss, working orders and the fills so far, with close, reverse and cancel, and an order ticket. A toolbar button opens it. Default `true` when trading is on.

ChartWidget.name: layouts
ChartWidget.doc: Named layouts: a toolbar button to save the chart (symbol, interval, scale, chart type, indicators, drawings, alerts) under a name, open, rename and delete layouts, and auto-save the one open; Ctrl/Cmd+S saves. Kept in this browser's `localStorage` unless `storage` says otherwise. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: indicatorTemplates
ChartWidget.doc: Indicator templates: the Templates tab of the Indicators dialog saves the chart's indicators (inputs, style, levels, panes) under a name and applies them in one go. Kept in this browser's `localStorage`. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: intervalTyping
ChartWidget.doc: Type a number on the chart (after using it) to change the interval: `5`, `15m`, `1h`, `1D`, then Enter. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: chartMenuItems
ChartWidget.doc: Your own entries at the end of the chart's right-click menus (and of the "+" by the price axis), after the widget's. Called each time a menu opens.

ChartWidget.name: drawingMenuItems
ChartWidget.doc: Your own entries at the end of a drawing's right-click menu. Called each time it opens.

ChartWidget.name: indicatorMenuItems
ChartWidget.doc: Your own entries at the end of an indicator's "more" menu (on its row on the chart).

ChartWidget.name: symbols
ChartWidget.doc: The symbols on offer, as tickers or `SymbolInfo`. Only a name, `type`, `exchange` and `logo` are used, by the symbol search, the toolbar's symbol and the symbol info panel: price steps and hours given here are not applied to the chart (those come from the adapter's `resolveSymbol` or `chart.setSymbolInfo`).

ChartWidget.name: customTimeframes
ChartWidget.doc: Let users type their own intervals (7m, 90m, 2h…) in the timeframe menu. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: adapter
ChartWidget.doc: Your data feed: the widget connects it and loads each symbol and interval the user picks. Without one nothing connects, Binance or any other: the widget shows the bars you give `setData`.

ChartWidget.name: searchSymbols
ChartWidget.doc: Search symbols as the user types in the symbol search (names, exchanges). Defaults to the adapter's `searchSymbols`; without either, the search filters `symbols`.

ChartWidget.name: historyPageSize
ChartWidget.doc: Bars per request when scrolling back for older bars (adapters with `fetchHistoryBefore`). Default 500.

ChartWidget.name: watchlist
ChartWidget.doc: A watchlist, a panel of the dock beside the chart: lists of symbols with last price, % change and a mini sparkline; lists can be added, renamed, deleted and reordered. `true` starts with one list of `symbols`. Default `false`.

ChartWidget.name: symbolInfo
ChartWidget.doc: The symbol info panel (names, price and move, market status, the day's numbers, hours, news) and its toolbar button. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: navigation
ChartWidget.doc: Buttons over the chart, shown while the pointer is on it: zoom out and in, scroll earlier and later, reset the view. Default `true`.

ChartWidget.name: dir
ChartWidget.doc: Writing direction of the widget's chrome: `'rtl'` mirrors the toolbar, drawing tools, menus and dialogs (the chart keeps time running left to right). Default `'auto'`: right to left for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu.

ChartWidget.name: news
ChartWidget.doc: Headlines for the symbol info panel, newest first; default the adapter's `fetchNews` when it has one. Links that aren't web pages are dropped.

ChartWidget.name: dragDropImport
ChartWidget.doc: Drag-and-drop CSV / JSON file import onto the chart. Default `true`. Set to `false` to disable (e.g. if the chart sits inside a larger surface that already handles drops).

ChartWidget.name: resampleTimeframes
ChartWidget.doc: Client-side timeframe resampling. When enabled (default `true`) and no live adapter is attached, switching to a coarser timeframe aggregates the loaded base series instead of refetching — one dataset drives every resolution. Disable to keep the timeframe buttons purely as a `onTimeframeChange` signal for the host app to refetch.

ChartWidget.name: weekStartsOn
ChartWidget.doc: Anchor day for weekly resample buckets. `0` = Sunday, `1` = Monday (default).

ChartWidget.name: shareUrl
ChartWidget.doc: Deep-linking. When `true`, the widget restores a `#tcw=<encoded>` view from the URL hash on load, and the "Share View" command writes one back. Use `exportState()` / `importState()` for manual control.

ChartWidget.name: drawingFavorites
ChartWidget.doc: Drawing tools to pre-pin to the favorites strip at the top of the drawing sidebar on first run. Users pin/unpin any tool by right-clicking it; the set persists to localStorage. The strip is always available (hidden while empty) — this option only seeds the initial pins.

ChartWidget.name: onReady
ChartWidget.doc: The widget is built: called once, with its chart and the widget itself, in a microtask after `new ChartWidget()` returns, so the name you give the widget is set by then. The statements right after the constructor run first (a `setData` there comes before it), and a view shared in the URL (`shareUrl`) is put back after it.

Chart.name: chartType
Chart.doc: Default `'candlestick'`.

Chart.name: barLayout
Chart.doc: How a bar fills its slot: `'golden'`, the body φ⁻¹ of the slot at every zoom (more bars on screen, air between them), or `'classic'` (the default), a 2 px gap. Change it with `chart.setBarLayout`.

Chart.name: grid
Chart.doc: The grid's lines: shorthand for the `grid.*` overrides.

Chart.name: crosshair
Chart.doc: The crosshair's mode, and its lines: shorthand for the `crosshair.*` overrides.

Chart.name: overrides
Chart.doc: Style overrides to start with, on the host's layer: any part of the chart's look, by key (`'grid.vertical.visible': false`, `'series.candlestick.upColor': '#26a69a'`, which colours the rising candles' wicks too). `CHART_STYLE_KEYS` lists the keys; see `chart.applyOverrides`.

Chart.name: logScale
Chart.doc: Start with logarithmic price scale

Chart.name: sessionBreaks
Chart.doc: Session break line configuration

Chart.name: features
Chart.doc: Feature toggles — control what users can access

Chart.name: numberLocale
Chart.doc: BCP 47 locale for number formatting (e.g. 'en-US', 'de-DE', 'vi-VN'). Defaults to 'en-US'.

Chart.name: freePan
Chart.doc: Free panning (default `true`): drag past the newest bar into empty future space, or past the oldest bar, until `panLimits.minVisibleBars` bars remain. `false` restores the pre-1.3 clamp (newest bar stops at its resting position).

Chart.name: timeZone
Chart.doc: Time zone for the time axis, crosshair, tooltip, day breaks and range presets: an IANA zone (`'America/New_York'`, daylight saving included), a fixed offset in minutes east of UTC, `'exchange'` for the symbol's zone or else its market's (`setTimeZone`), or null (default) for the browser's.

Chart.name: leftPriceScale
Chart.doc: Show a price scale on the left too. It carries the overlays put on it (`addIndicator(…, { scale: 'left' })`), else it mirrors the price scale. It shows by itself once an overlay is on it.

Chart.name: panLimits
Chart.doc: Bounds for free panning.

Chart.name: maxPixelRatio
Chart.doc: The highest device pixel ratio the chart draws at. Default 2: a 3x phone screen is drawn at 2x, 56% fewer pixels and less than half the canvas memory for lines barely softer. `Infinity` draws at the screen's own.

Chart.name: pauseWhenHidden
Chart.doc: Stop drawing while no one can see the chart: scrolled off screen, or the page hidden (another tab, the app in the background). Data, indicators and alerts keep up; the frame missed is drawn on return. Default true. `suspend()` / `resume()` pause it from the host (a WebView's app paused).

Chart.name: pageScroll
Chart.doc: For a chart on a page that scrolls (an article, a phone screen): a one-finger vertical swipe and the plain mouse wheel scroll the page; a sideways swipe pans the chart, and two fingers or Ctrl + wheel (a trackpad pinch) zoom it. Presses on drawings, lines and axes stay the chart's. Default false: the chart takes every gesture over it.

Chart.name: minBarUnit
Chart.doc: How narrow a bar slot may get to fit a long series on screen (zooming out, `fitContent`, the 'All' range), px. Default 0.25: four bars a pixel, so 26 years of daily bars don't all fit on a laptop screen. Down to 0.02 (50 bars a pixel); below a pixel bars are drawn a pixel column at a time.

Chart.name: priceFormat
Chart.doc: How prices read on the price scale and everything that prints one (axis, crosshair, last-price tag, legend, tooltip, orders, alerts, drawings): a function of yours, or fractions of a point (a bond in 32nds: `101'16`). Indicator panes keep their own numbers. Default: decimals.

Chart.name: timeFormatter
Chart.doc: How times read on the time axis, the crosshair and the tooltip. Default: the chart's own.

Chart.name: chartTypeOptions
Chart.doc: Settings of Renko, Line Break, Kagi, Point & Figure and range bars.

Chart.name: highLowLines
Chart.doc: Mark the highest high and lowest low on screen with a line and a price tag.

Chart.name: shapes
Chart.doc: The shapes the chart draws: price tags, axis pills and order badges square (default), rounded or pills.

Chart.name: font
Chart.doc: The face and sizes of the chart's own text (the axes, the tags, the crosshair's pills) over every theme: `{ family: SANS_FONT_FAMILY }` for proportional figures. The legend takes the face, at its own size (`chart.setLegend({ fontSize })`); in a widget its face and size come from the look (`ui.font`). Change it with `chart.setFont`.

Chart.name: a11y
Chart.doc: The chart for screen readers: a summary, what is on screen after the keys move it, comma and period to read the bars. On by default; labels in your language here; `false` leaves it out.

Chart.name: renderer
Chart.doc: What draws the plot and panes: `'canvas'` (Canvas 2D, the default), `'webgl'` (WebGL 2 on the GPU, Canvas 2D where it can't be had) or `'auto'` (WebGL 2 where the GPU is a real one).

Chart.name: extendedHours
Chart.doc: Show the bars outside the symbol's regular hours (`SymbolInfo.sessions`): pre- and post-market. Default true; bars a day or longer are never left out.

Chart.name: plugins
Chart.doc: Plugins to install with the chart: indicators, drawing tools, chart types and overlays of your own.

ChartWidgetGrid.name: layout
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: How the charts are arranged. Default `'1x2'` (two side by side).

ChartWidgetGrid.name: layoutChoices
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: The arrangements the bar offers. Default all of them.

ChartWidgetGrid.name: widget
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: Options for every chart. Leave `adapter` out of these when there is more than one chart: an adapter keeps one stream, so each chart needs its own (see `adapter`).

ChartWidgetGrid.name: adapter
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: Makes each chart's data adapter, `new BinanceAdapter()` say; called once per chart.

ChartWidgetGrid.name: cells
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: Each chart's own options, by position (its symbol and interval, say), over `widget`.

ChartWidgetGrid.name: sync
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: What the charts follow from each other; see {@link DEFAULT_GRID_SYNC}.

ChartWidgetGrid.name: layouts
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: Named layouts of the whole grid (arrangement, sync and every chart). Default `true`.

ChartWidgetGrid.name: bar
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: The bar above the charts: arrangement, sync, layouts. Default `true`.

ChartWidgetGrid.name: onActiveChange
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: The chart in use changed (pressed, or the grid shrank).

ChartWidgetGrid.name: onChartAdd
ChartWidgetGrid.doc: A chart was made: at the start, and when the grid grows. Feed it data, add indicators…

ChartWidget.chartOptions.name: chartType
ChartWidget.chartOptions.doc: Default `'candlestick'`.

Chart.features.name: drawings
Chart.features.doc: Enable drawing tools entirely. When false, no drawing tool can be activated.

Chart.features.name: drawingTools
Chart.features.doc: Whitelist of allowed drawing tool types. When set, only these tools are available.

Chart.features.name: drawingMagnet
Chart.features.doc: Allow magnet/snap for drawing anchors. When false, `setDrawingMagnet(true)` is ignored.

Chart.features.name: trading
Chart.features.doc: Enable trading features (orders, positions, context menu)

Chart.features.name: tradingContextMenu
Chart.features.doc: Right-click menu for placing orders. Default `false` — opt in explicitly.

Chart.features.name: priceAxisAddButton
Chart.features.doc: A "+" by the price axis, level with the crosshair; a click on it emits `priceAxisAdd` with the price. Default `false` (ChartWidget turns it on).

Chart.features.name: indicatorIds
Chart.features.doc: Whitelist of allowed indicator IDs. When set, only these are available.

Chart.features.name: crosshairTooltip
Chart.features.doc: Show the floating OHLCV tooltip that follows the cursor on hover. Pro trading charts usually rely on the top-left legend (`legend`) instead of a cursor-following popup — set this to `false` to match that and keep only the legend updating on hover.

Chart.features.name: indicatorValueLabels
Chart.features.doc: Tag each indicator line's latest value on its value axis. Default false: the legend shows the values.

Chart.features.name: barCountdown
Chart.features.doc: Show bar countdown timer (time until current candle closes). When false it stays hidden.

Chart.features.name: compareSymbols
Chart.features.doc: Enable compare/overlay symbols. When false, `addCompareSymbol` does nothing.

Chart.features.name: dataExport
Chart.features.doc: Enable data export (CSV/JSON). When false, `exportVisibleData` / `exportAllData` do nothing.

Chart.features.name: logScale
Chart.features.doc: Allow the logarithmic price scale. When false, switching to it is ignored.

Chart.features.name: timeframes
Chart.features.doc: Whitelist of timeframes. When set, `setTimeframe` ignores any other, and ChartWidget offers only these.

Chart.features.name: defaultTimeframeFavorites
Chart.features.doc: ChartWidget: timeframes on the quick-access bar until the user changes them.
